newsitem.title: USA: S3 Inc sees Q2 results down from Q1.
newsitem.headline: S3 Inc sees Q2 results down from Q1.

text.p: S3 Inc on Monday said it expects its second quarter results will fall below the first quarter, ended March 31, due to seasonality and competition in its market for computer equipment and software.
"On a cyclical basis the second quarter is the weakest in our industry and the market is currently experiencing substantial pricing pressure," Gary Johnson, chief executive, said in a statement.
"Consequently, we anticipate our operating results will be lower than those in the first quarter," he added.
Earlier, the company reported first quarter earnings of $0.31 per share on revenue of $138 million versus $0.25 a share on sales of $110 million one year ago.
In the second quarter ended June 30, 1996, S3 earned $0.18 a share on sales of $103 million.
In a statement, Johnson said company management looks to the second half of 1997 with "cautious optimism" as it launches new products.
S3 is a supplier of computer multimedia acceleration hardware and software.
